cohorts.selection_rule: Top ceil(N*0.25) by public views per complete day; N=24, q=6; deterministic video_id tie-break.
limitations: Public views are a point-in-time count and do not expose impressions or retention.

cohorts.selection_rule: Middle N-2*ceil(N*0.25) by public views per complete day; N=24, q=6.
limitations: The middle band is descriptive; it is not a causal control group.

cohorts.selection_rule: Bottom ceil(N*0.25) by public views per complete day; N=24, q=6; deterministic video_id tie-break.
limitations: Low public velocity does not identify the cause of underperformance.

cohorts.selection_rule: Latest 6 rankable format-reference videos by public publication timestamp.
limitations: Period cohort may mix platform, seasonality, and editorial changes.

cohorts.selection_rule: Highest public views per complete day among the collected sample of each format/market/speed reference channel.
limitations: Different channel sizes, catalog ages, audiences, and collection limits make this a descriptive comparison only.
No monetization approval, RPM, retention, or traffic-source equivalence is observable publicly.

channel_dna.audience: English-speaking, belief-aligned Christian viewers facing uncertainty, delay, spiritual pressure, identity questions, or fear and seeking meaning plus a concrete faithful response.
channel_dna.job_to_be_done: Convert an emotionally charged struggle into a biblically framed mechanism, discernment, and one actionable identity/faith response without pretending certainty the evidence cannot support.
channel_dna.editorial_promise: HeroVerse explains the spiritual tension behind a recognizable struggle and earns an original action/identity payoff in concise cinematic English storytelling.
channel_dna.point_of_view: Pressure is not automatically proof of rejection or chosen superiority; meaning must be argued with context, evidence, humility, and a faithful response.
differentiation: Direct second-person tension from the existing HeroVerse packaging, but without generic chosen-one flattery.
Mechanism and contextual proof before emotional crescendo.
Clip-based cinematic language whose sources are rights-audited and semantically assigned, not copied from a reference identity.
Explicit separation of observed evidence, hypothesis, and unavailable divine/platform/economic certainty.

visual: CANDIDATE: HeroVerse-owned visual system must be created; reference medieval/battle identity is not inherited.
Each visual is tagged by narrative job and rights status.
audio: CANDIDATE: authorized English narrator with controlled escalation.
No cloned reference voice; licensed music and intelligible speech are mandatory.

packaging_grammar: one tension + one consequence + one answerable promise
second-person relevance when body evidence supports it
thumbnail adds contradiction/consequence rather than copying title
retention_mechanisms: one open loop at a time

format_archetypes.name: Direct Spiritual Stakes to Identity/Action Payoff
format_archetypes.function: Turn an English Christian-motivation tension into a concrete spiritual mechanism, evidence, and an original action/identity resolution.
format_archetypes.audience_intent: Belief-aligned viewers seeking meaning, courage, discernment, and a next faithful action during pressure or uncertainty.

packaging_rules.description: Define one tension + one spiritual consequence; title and thumbnail must form one promise, not two competing ideas.
Use HeroVerse-specific second-person identity/timing language only when the body can prove and resolve it; do not copy the reference suffix or typography.
Thumbnail adds a consequence or contradiction in 1–4 original words and never repeats the exact title.

hook_rules.description: 0–1s: state a concrete tension or contradiction; no greeting, logo-only bumper, or contextless dialogue.
1–3s: name the spiritual anchor and the personal consequence promised by the packaging.
3–8s: reveal the mechanism or proof direction and open one answerable loop.
8–30s: pay off the first claim with context and stakes; do not delay the advertised topic behind cinematic dialogue.
Treat cut density and speech-start time as production variables, not success invariants.

beat_sheet.objective: State a concrete spiritual conflict, consequence, or promise in the viewer's terms.
beat_sheet.retention_function: Resolve packaging ambiguity and create one precise open loop.

beat_sheet.objective: Translate the spiritual thesis into a recognizable decision, fear, delay, or cost.
beat_sheet.retention_function: Make the question personally consequential without adding a second thesis.

beat_sheet.objective: Explain how the pressure works and provide context-preserving authority or evidence.
beat_sheet.retention_function: Pay off the first loop and open a practical one.

beat_sheet.objective: Replace the false response with a concrete faithful response.
beat_sheet.retention_function: Convert interpretation into escalating action and micro-payoffs.

beat_sheet.objective: Resolve the exact title promise in a memorable original line and one next action.
beat_sheet.retention_function: Deliver satisfaction; do not introduce an unrelated topic.

invariants.description: One packaging promise remains the controlling thesis from hook through payoff.
The first audible unit is self-contained and reaches a concrete spiritual anchor without borrowed context.
Progression includes stake, mechanism/proof, reversal/action, and title-aligned resolution.
Every third-party clip has a rights status, truthful context, provenance, and named narrative job.

variables.description: Topic, angle, scripture, example, emotion, visual world, CTA, and proof source are replaceable slots.
Beat duration may move inside observed ratio ranges; five to seven complete segments were observed.
Original narration, licensed excerpt, public-domain image, motion graphic, self-shot footage, or typography may perform a beat when rights and context pass.

prohibited.description: Do not reuse the reference channel's exact title suffix, logo, thumbnail composition, cinematic sequence, wording, voice, or music identity.
Do not reorder a source speech to reverse meaning, hide provenance, evade Content ID, or treat public availability as permission.
Do not use a percentage-of-change rule as proof of originality or rights.
Do not make prophecy dates, guaranteed divine claims, or monetization/RPM claims without evidence.

visual_grammar.description: Assign each visual a semantic job (stake, evidence, contrast, mechanism, action, payoff) before sourcing it.
Build a HeroVerse-owned palette and composition system; similarity to medieval/battle imagery is optional, never an identity requirement.
Use on-screen text only at structural turns and keep it original, legible, and non-duplicative of the complete title.

audio_grammar.description: Use an authorized English narrator with clear, controlled escalation; voice cloning requires explicit rights and is otherwise prohibited.
Music supports beat transitions and payoff but must not mask speech; every track requires a reusable-rights record.
Third-party speech is evidence or contrast, not the entire narrative spine; preserve its context and identify its job.

examples.reason: Winner: concrete warfare packaging, armor-of-God anchor, escalating mechanism, daily resistance, and Christ-centered resolution.
Winner/recent: confrontation becomes urgency, prophecy, practical orders, and personal responsibility.

counterexamples.reason: Weak: title promises purpose, but contextless cinematic dialogue delays the religious premise to about 41 seconds.
Median: thesis starts clearly, but thumbnail/action-film world and final visual silence weaken proof/payoff alignment.

format_archetypes.production_complexity: HIGH; clip-based rights review, semantic continuity, narration, sound design, and visual QA required.

limitations: Only four complete narratives; score is a deterministic coverage/recurrence index, not a performance probability.
Weights are frozen evidence-depth weights; score describes coverage, not statistical confidence or performance probability.

originality_control_coverage_score.scale: 0-1 share of six required originality-control slots specified
originality_control_coverage_score.formula: specified original slots / 6: title, thumbnail, voice, rhetorical sequence, visual system, payoff
limitations: Control coverage does not prove that a future blueprint or render is original; both require independent audit.

policy_exposure_screen_score.scale: 0-1 share of five predefined policy exposure flags present
policy_exposure_screen_score.formula: 4 present flags / 5 screened: clip-based reuse, unresolved reference rights, automation/repetition, prophecy-overclaim; voice-clone request absent
limitations: This is a binary exposure screen, not a probability of policy action or legal conclusion.

cross_channel_validation_score.scale: 0-1 share of required independent channels with full mined confirmation
cross_channel_validation_score.formula: 0 independent channels with FULL_VALIDATED narrative confirmation / minimum target 3
limitations: Cross-channel metadata exists but does not count as narrative-mechanism validation.

rpm_evidence_score.scale: 0-1 higher means actual owned RPM evidence
rpm_evidence_score.formula: 1 if authenticated owned RPM series exists and is sufficient; otherwise 0
limitations: No economic ranking is permitted before owned post-YPP data.

hypotheses.statement: For HeroVerse long-form, a title-aligned spiritual anchor and personal consequence in the first eight seconds will outperform delayed/context-dependent dialogue on 30-second retention.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if, across at least six comparable owned long-form releases with age-matched measurement, direct-anchor openings do not improve 30-second retention versus the preregistered baseline beyond uncertainty.
hypotheses.test_design: Preregister six long-form pilots; hold topic/length/age window as comparable as possible; vary only opener class; evaluate owned 30s retention with interval and baseline.

hypotheses.statement: Given HeroVerse's current 20-Short/1-long catalog and the evidence-sufficient long archetype, long-form is the primary test path for qualified watch hours; Shorts remain supporting discovery tests.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Suspend if comparable owned long-form pilots fail watch-hours-per-production-hour and subscriber conversion stop rules while Shorts show materially stronger qualified organic progress.
hypotheses.test_design: Measure owned long vs Short organic outcomes at fixed ages; exclude paid views/hours/subscribers; compare qualified watch hours, subscriber conversion, and production time with uncertainty.

hypotheses.statement: Assigning every clip a narrative job and semantic relation to the spoken beat will reduce promise/body mismatch versus generic cinematic montage.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Reject if blind editorial review and owned retention diagnostics show no improvement in alignment or segment drop-off against the preregistered baseline.
hypotheses.test_design: Blind-score blueprint/render semantic alignment before publication; compare segment retention and reviewer agreement after publication.

hypotheses.statement: Long-form may produce higher owned RPM/value per qualified view than Shorts, but the direction and magnitude are unknown for HeroVerse.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Replace with observed rule only after YPP and a sufficient owned series; reject the direction if age/topic-adjusted actual net value does not exceed Shorts.
hypotheses.test_design: After YPP, compare authenticated RPM, net contribution, watch hours and production cost by format; do not optimize on CPM proxies.

evidence_matrix.statement: The reference population repeatedly uses compact all-caps spiritual declarations plus a niche label (observed suffix rate 100.0%).
limitations: A repeatable reference convention is not permission to copy its exact suffix, typography, or identity.

evidence_matrix.statement: Winner openings more often place a spiritual anchor inside the first 20 spoken words (66.7%) than weak openings (50.0%).
limitations: Opening labels are retrospective public cohorts; retention and causality are unavailable.

evidence_matrix.statement: Context-dependent/dialogue starts appear in 66.7% of weak openings versus 0.0% of winner openings under the frozen lexical rule.
limitations: The lexical rule is small-sample and cannot measure whether a viewer understood the opener.

evidence_matrix.statement: First-speech timing is similar across winner and weak openings (median 6.65s vs 6.69s).
limitations: This does not imply a silent bumper is optimal for HeroVerse; it only failed to separate these public cohorts.

evidence_matrix.statement: Cut count through 30s does not cleanly separate winner and weak cohorts (median 7.5 vs 5.5).
limitations: Cut detection uses one threshold and does not capture shot meaning or audio transitions.

evidence_matrix.statement: Across the four complete cases, the repeatable mechanism is progression from a spiritual stake to explanation/proof, then an action or identity payoff; exact beat counts vary from five to seven.
limitations: Only four complete narratives exist; the beat sheet is a pilot hypothesis, not a general rule.

evidence_matrix.statement: HeroVerse public packaging currently emphasizes second-person identity, divine timing, warning, hidden preparation, spiritual warfare, and chosen-purpose language.
limitations: Only titles and public metadata were analyzed for the 20 Shorts and one long-form; visual/audio identity is unverified.

evidence_matrix.statement: Actual RPM, revenue, qualified watch hours, CTR, and retention are unavailable and cannot rank formats economically.
limitations: Any high-RPM statement before authenticated post-YPP data is a hypothesis, not a measurement.

input_requirements: One English audience tension and one answerable spiritual/editorial question.
One original thesis and title-payoff statement written for HeroVerse.
A source manifest containing only owned, public-domain, licensed, or review-approved assets.
At least one context-preserving proof source; scripture must be cited and interpreted in context.
A rights status, provenance URI, intended narrative job, and timecode for every clip candidate.
generation_specs.editorial_question: What precise spiritual tension is the viewer facing, what mechanism explains it, and what truthful action/identity resolution can this video earn?

packaging.thumbnail_rule: 1–4 original words that add consequence or contradiction; never copy the reference layout or repeat the whole title.
packaging.reject_if: The hook cannot name and start resolving the same promise in eight seconds.

hook.0_1_seconds: Concrete tension/contradiction in the viewer's terms.
hook.3_8_seconds: Mechanism/proof direction + one answerable open loop.
hook.8_30_seconds: First payoff, context, stakes, and transition to the body.

narrative.objective: State a concrete spiritual conflict, consequence, or promise in the viewer's terms.
narrative.retention_function: Resolve packaging ambiguity and create one precise open loop.

narrative.objective: Translate the spiritual thesis into a recognizable decision, fear, delay, or cost.
narrative.retention_function: Make the question personally consequential without adding a second thesis.

narrative.objective: Explain how the pressure works and provide context-preserving authority or evidence.
narrative.retention_function: Pay off the first loop and open a practical one.

narrative.objective: Replace the false response with a concrete faithful response.
narrative.retention_function: Convert interpretation into escalating action and micro-payoffs.

narrative.objective: Resolve the exact title promise in a memorable original line and one next action.
narrative.retention_function: Deliver satisfaction; do not introduce an unrelated topic.

clip_policy.percentage_rule: NONE; no modification percentage guarantees originality or rights.

originality_controls: Write thesis, sequence, transitions, payoff, title, thumbnail, narration, and visual concept for HeroVerse from a blank document.
Use references only for mechanism evidence; never use one source video's order as the new timeline.
Compare semantic sequence, wording, visual identity, audio identity, and source concentration against every reference before release.
Require substantive new purpose/context for each excerpt and reject cosmetic transformations.
quality_gates: Packaging contains one precise promise and hook matches it by 0–8s.
All five functional beats exist, each with a micro-payoff and evidence refs.
No segment exists solely as decorative footage or borrowed rhetoric.
Final payoff answers the title without unsupported certainty.
Rights manifest has no UNKNOWN or analysis-only asset in a production slot.
Narration is intelligible; audio peaks, captions, black frames, and render settings pass technical QA.
Model confidence and untested hypotheses remain visible in the production review.
rejection_rules: Reject if the opening depends on missing source context or delays the advertised subject past eight seconds.
Reject if title/thumbnail resembles a reference identity more than the HeroVerse concept.
Reject if proof is absent, decontextualized, or replaced by fearbait/chosen-one superiority.
Reject if any clip's rights or provenance is unresolved.
Reject if the timeline reproduces a reference's distinctive take or rhetorical sequence.

retrospective_validation.method: Frozen public quartiles by views per complete day; four full cases explain narrative differences; 13 Phase-2 holdout opening files measure only 0–30s mechanics.

case_explanations.explanation: Strong promise-to-body fit: warfare immediately becomes armor, threat, authority, daily resistance, and Christ-centered resolution.
Confrontational opening, urgency, eschatological mechanism, ordered actions, and personal-responsibility close explain archetype fit.
contrary_factors: title subject becomes explicit after the initial confrontation

case_explanations.explanation: The thesis starts clearly and progresses through protection/adversary logic, but visual fantasy/action mismatch and a long silent end weaken earned proof/payoff.
contrary_factors: action montage does not prove theological claims

case_explanations.explanation: The eventual restoration thesis is coherent, but the opening spends about 41 seconds in abstract cinematic dialogue before defining the spiritual promise.

limitations: No retention/CTR/impressions.
Only four full narratives.
Holdout is relative to Phase 2 fixtures, not necessarily to all earlier heuristic development.
Public views/day is age-normalized but not audience- or traffic-source-normalized.

knowledge_state.statement: HeroVerse has 1 public long-form and 20 public Shorts in the frozen capture.
Grace quartiles contain 6 winner, 12 median, and 6 weak videos by public views per complete day.
The long-form archetype is fit for a controlled pilot review, not for scale.
Cross-channel metadata does not prove the archetype transfers across independent channels.
Actual RPM, revenue, margin, and YPP probability are unavailable.

value_hypotheses: Long-form may create more qualified watch-hour value than the existing Short catalog.
Actual format RPM ranking must wait for owned post-YPP data.

limitations: The model explains correlations and editorial differences; it does not predict views or guarantee YPP.
Only four videos have full validated narrative/take coverage.
The 13 additional opening holdouts cannot support body/payoff rules.
HeroVerse Shorts have metadata but no audiovisual mining; no Shorts archetype is claimed.
No actual RPM, revenue, CTR, retention, watch hours, or subscriber conversion exists in the approved dataset.
Reference assets, wording, voice, layout, sequence, and identity are analysis-only and not production inputs.
